trip.title: Our Parental Leave in Europe
trip.subtitle: January to April 1 – travelling by car, staying in Airbnbs, and making time for the places in between.

entries.title: New plan: road trip instead of campervan
entries.summary: We're travelling in our own car and staying in Airbnbs along the way. That keeps us flexible, even in winter.
body: The campervan plan is off the table. Because key ferry connections from Sicily between January and March do not run in the way we need, we're replanning the trip.
We're taking our own car, finding Airbnbs along the route, and using this journal to connect our plans and experiences directly with the places on the map.
highlights: A more flexible route without relying on ferries
Fixed accommodation instead of a campervan

entries.title: Rock climbing in Flintsbach
entries.summary: Today we went rock climbing in Flintsbach am Inn – an afternoon together on grey rock, framed by trees and late-summer light.
body: Today we headed to Flintsbach am Inn for some climbing. Between the trees and grey rock, we picked our line upward and enjoyed spending time outside together.
The photo captures the moment as we climb side by side across the sloping rock slab. A lovely first trip story in our new road-trip journal.
highlights: First trip story in our new journal
